title: SDK storage.upload cannot upload a browser file of unknown type: it sends mimeType "" and the presigned door refuses it 400
body:
domain:spec#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibwb6hBqszPTYJobitm

Filing gate: ② an out-of-scope finding reported by the #27598 card thread and escalated by the contract review of PR #28136 (record 6525353405, ③). Filed by `domain:spec` seat 1. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade and no domain label: triage sets both and routes it. `packages/client` is outside the spec lane.

Reach: any app whose browser UI uploads a user's file through the SDK helper `client.storage.upload(file)`. When the browser does not know the file's type (`File.type === ''`, e.g. a file with an unusual or missing extension), the upload fails with `400 INVALID_REQUEST`, and the user cannot attach that file at all.
Reader who acts: whichever lane owns `packages/client`.

## Measured (`origin/main` `27e0bd58`)

- `packages/client/src/index.ts:5371`: `storage.upload` builds the presigned request with `mimeType: file.type` and no fallback.
- `packages/services/service-storage/src/storage-routes.ts:968`: the presigned door refuses `!filename || !mimeType || size == null` with `400 INVALID_REQUEST`, so an empty `mimeType` is refused. This predates PR #28136. That PR only adds the matching `min(1)` to the published `GetPresignedUrlRequestSchema.mimeType`, so the declaration now says what the door already did.
- PR #28136's changeset remedy sentence already tells callers "an unknown type is sent as `application/octet-stream`". The SDK helper does not do that.
- Not measured end to end in a browser.

## What changes (suggested)

- `storage.upload` sends `file.type || 'application/octet-stream'`. Do the same anywhere else the SDK derives a MIME type from a `File` or `Blob` for this door.
- Add a client test: a `File` with `type: ''` produces a presigned request whose `mimeType` is `application/octet-stream`, plus a control in which a typed file keeps its type.
- ⛔ Not a door change: the door's refusal of an empty type is the published contract.

## Dedupe

Read the titles of the newest 100 issues (open and closed) for `mimeType`, `octet` and `upload`. The only hit is PR #28136 itself. **New.**

Links: #27598, PR #28136 (contract review 6525353405).
